requirements.statement: Design Normalize SHALL identify materially compound obligations, ambiguity, contradiction, duplication, inappropriate implementation leakage, and missing semantic ownership.

The installed proposal registry SHALL record proposal identity, order, installed path, lifecycle state, bootstrap provenance, authority state, reconstruction dependencies, and predecessor/successor identities where applicable.
Bootstrap-installed seed proposal registry records SHALL use lifecycle state available, bootstrap provenance bootstrap-seed, and authority state none.
The proposal registry SHALL let a fresh agent enumerate available unprocessed successor Design Proposals and reconstruction dependencies without chat history.
After cutover, a bootstrap-installed seed proposal SHALL NOT be mutated in place.
In the fixed FS0 GitHub binding, Design governed work SHALL use a GitHub issue.
FS0 SHALL make current governed work and accepted realization intent machine-resolvable from repository and GitHub state without chat history.
Design, Plan, and Build SHALL be represented as distinct governed work.
Design SHALL audit accepted authority and relevant repository state.
Design SHALL normalize persistent normative semantics into identified requirements.
Design acceptance SHALL be realized by authorized merge of an eligible Design pull request associated with its governed Design issue.
Plan SHALL NOT create or amend normative semantics.
Build SHALL produce required evidence, invoke required Conformance, perform required semantic audit, and continue governed work rather than merge when that audit is adverse.
Build SHALL NOT invent Design semantics or Plan intent.
Governance acceptance SHALL be authorized merge of the exact conforming governed pull request after semantic audit; that merge SHALL also record candidate Assurance satisfaction.
Completion or acceptance of governed work SHALL NOT independently authorize unrelated or successor work.
refs/heads/main SHALL change accepted repository state only through an authorized merge of an eligible governed pull request.
The external bootstrap provenance issue SHALL anchor exactly one designated bootstrap-cutover acceptance pull request and SHALL NOT be FS0-governed work.
Privileged mutation SHALL remain bounded by accepted authority, accepted Plan, and authorized Build scope.
No bootstrap-only mechanism SHALL independently create accepted framework state after cutover.
